what: A blog comparing Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Polar reports that as of March 2026, Gumroad holds a Google Trends search score of 50 versus Lemon Squeezy at 2 and Polar below 1, though interest in alternatives has risen following Gumroad's fee increases.
